title: Arithmetic locally symmetric spaces and their cohomology, Part II: weight-aspect multiplicity bounds
summary: Target-level plan of Fu’s sharp weight-aspect multiplicity bounds: a common multiaffine error for rational Iwasawa homology, its fixed-level SL₂/F application, and source-qualified Bianchi sharpness with the boundary terms retained. The issue’s other three independent continuations are proposed as a split. Every target in this six-stage scope is planned; two unadopted supplier contracts are explicit gaps, so this is not a closed packet.
readme: This continuation proves the sharp fixed-level weight-aspect upper bound dim S_κ≤C Δ(κ)/min_vκ_v for SL₂ over a number field with a complex place. Its local endpoint bounds the rank error in degree-zero rational Iwasawa homology and every positive homology group by one multiaffine polynomial of degree at most m−1, for all nonnegative local weights. It then proves the parallel degree drop, the Bianchi linear upper bound and two-sided growth at the justified base-change levels. The reader states the full targets, API, checks, source corrections, supplier contracts and the independent-direction split. The plan does not assert a leading constant, a lower bound at arbitrary adelic level, or a totally real saving.

stages.title: Weights and multiaffine errors
stages.description: For a finite coordinate set of size m≥1 define D(x)=∏x_i and B_c(x)=Σ_{s proper}c_s∏_{i∈s}x_i with c_s≥0. Specify reindexing, addition and degree APIs and prove B_c(x)≤(Σc_s)D(x)/a for 1≤a≤all x_i. Restrict existing symmetric-power representations to the product of m odd-p first-congruence SL₂ groups, with stable lattices, absolute irreducibility, self-duality and dim W_k=D(k+1). The representation and Iwasawa carriers retain their suppliers.

stages.title: Torsion multiplicities
stages.description: For the bounded-denominator rational Iwasawa algebra A and every nonzero δ, prove dim Hom_A(A/Aδ,W_k)≤B_δ(k+1) for every k∈ℕ^m, through the explicit G1 microlocal/central-faithfulness and G2 completed-enveloping growth contracts. Include all low-coordinate strips. Compare Hom with rational completed degree-zero homology using the contragredient and then self-duality. Filter every finitely generated rank-zero module by cyclic factors dominated by principal quotients and add their proper-face bounds. The two unadopted analytic supplier contracts remain explicit gaps.

stages.title: Ranks and all homological degrees
stages.description: For finitely generated left A-module M of skew rank a, choose a rank-a free injection with torsion cokernel and a finite free presentation with kernel of rank ℓ−a. Untwist diagonal free coefficients and prove regular acyclicity. Establish separate degree-zero upper and lower estimates, then the absolute rank error. Cancel rank main terms in the degree-one exact dimension identity; shift higher degrees through syzygies. Obtain one nonnegative multiaffine error of degree ≤m−1 for all k and all homological degrees, with vanishing above 3m. Give the constant bound and finite algebraic-quotient support when canonical dimension is zero.

stages.title: Arithmetic realization and descent
stages.description: For a number field of degree d and an arbitrary fixed compact open, choose an odd prime completely split in a normal closure outside the nonmaximal primes, and refine to a neat level with exactly d first-congruence p-adic factors. Match even place weights κ_v≥2 with local weights κ_v−2 at real places and two copies of κ_v/2−1 at complex places. Construct the finite-number-field realization and its complex/p-adic coefficient comparison. When r₂>0, supplied completed ordinary homology is finitely generated of rank zero; its finite descent filtration gives one proper-face bound for every ordinary Betti dimension.

stages.title: Cuspidal dimensions in weight aspect
stages.description: For SL₂/F in the stated weight convention, establish the nontrivial-coefficient identity dim H_cusp^(r₁+r₂)=2^r₁ dim S_κ and retain its injection into ordinary and interior cohomology. With r₂>0 and fixed arbitrary compact open K_f prove dim S_κ(K_f)≤C Δ(κ)/min_vκ_v uniformly for all even κ_v≥2, where Δ has one real and two complex factors. Absorb the single trivial-coefficient tuple separately. At fixed neat level prove the ordinary bound in every degree. Deduce parallel growth O(κ^(d−1)) and the Bianchi upper bound O(κ), equivalently O(n+1) for E_n with κ=2(n+1).

stages.title: Bianchi boundary and sharpness
stages.description: For a neat Bianchi quotient compute each cusp-torus E_n cohomology as dimensions 1,2,1 for all n≥0, and compare ordinary, interior and compact-support dimensions by the resulting uniform boundary constants. Prove the fixed-type classical estimate (k−1)dim σ/12+O(1) with the matching central parity, then the FGT base-change count (A_F+B_F(−1)^(n+1))(n+1)+O(1), with A_F>B_F≥0. Import exact quadratic transfer and ramified local-type inputs. For each fixed neat congruence subgroup of finite index in SL₂(O_F), deduce positive linear lower and upper bounds in degrees one and two for cuspidal, interior, ordinary and compact-support cohomology. No lower assertion at arbitrary adelic level is included.
